description_en: Deletes one or more SSH key pairs
description_zh: 调用DeleteKeyPairs删除一对或者多对SSH密钥对
name: DeleteKeyPairs

parameters.description_en: The region ID of the SSH key pairs. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.
parameters.description_zh: SSH密钥对所在的地域。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
parameters.help_en: The region ID of the SSH key pairs. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: SSH密钥对所在的地域。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.description_en:
The names of the SSH key pairs. The value is a JSON array of SSH key pair names. You can specify up to 100 SSH key pairs. Separate multiple names with commas (,).

> Before you delete SSH key pairs, you can call [DescribeKeyPairs](~~51773~~) to query existing key pairs.
parameters.description_zh:
SSH密钥对名称。取值可以由多个SSH密钥对名称组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100对SSH密钥对，名称之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。

>在进行删除SSH密钥对前，您可以调用[DescribeKeyPairs](~~51773~~)查询已有密钥对。
